summary: First session. Screened the big movers. Researched DOX (-30%, T-Mobile dispute plus FY27 guide cut), FIS (-24%, guide cut, CFO exit, JPM downgrade), UNM (-18%, GAAP loss), and TRMB (-17%, outlook cut). All were news-driven, so the drift pattern favors shorts. Opened shorts in FIS (6%) and UNM (5%) under the pattern 'news gap-down drift'. Passed on DOX because pre-market is +2.4% after a -30% crash and rebound risk is high. Passed on TRMB because the numbers were in line and ARR is growing, which makes it more of an overreaction candidate than a short. Passed on the upside movers: CRCT, RYTM, OPRT, TREE and DUOL were all news or earnings driven, and buying a gap-up at the open is a poor entry. Market context: SPY +1.65%, tech weak over 5 days (XLK -7.6%), oil -8%, gold up. Next session: check how FIS and UNM did against SPY, look for no-news moves to fade, and consider TRMB or DOX longs if they stabilize. Tip: inside code_execution, web_search returns a JSON string, so parse it with json.loads.
feedback: web_search in code_execution returns a JSON string rather than a list, which is not obvious from the docs. The digest has no pre-market prices for all names, but otherwise nothing held me back.
